findings.motion: S.2851 (driver's license for residents without legal presence), question on adoption of amendment 25 (Tarr and Moore), attestation not to use the license for voting, registering to vote or identification
findings.note: Roll call No. 165 lists Keenan among the Nays. The amendment would add to the applicant attestation that they will not use the license for voting or registering to vote or for identification. It was rejected 7 yeas to 31 nays. The week and vote count match the report at https://recorder.com/?p=195861 (published 2022-05-12). Amendment text: https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/192/S2851/25/Senate/Content
subjects: voting-related limits on a license issued without legal presence
proof of identity
non-citizen voting safeguards

findings.motion: S.2851, question on adoption of amendment 7 (Fattman, Moore, Montigny, Tarr), registry to give town clerks license-holder information to verify identity and eligibility to vote or register to vote
findings.note: Roll call No. 163 lists Keenan among the Nays. The amendment would require the registry of motor vehicles to give city or town clerks information on a license holder so the clerk can verify the identity and eligibility of anyone using the license to vote or register. It was rejected 10 yeas to 29 nays. Amendment text: https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/192/S2851/7/Senate/Content
subjects: verifying voter identity and eligibility
voter-roll checks
non-citizen voting safeguards

findings.motion: S.2851, question on adoption of amendment 3 (Tarr), license to bear the words 'Not valid for identification'
findings.note: Roll call No. 162 lists Keenan among the Nays. The amendment would print 'Not valid for identification' on licenses issued under the bill. It was rejected 7 yeas to 32 nays. This is about the license as a form of identification in general, not voting by name. Amendment text: https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/192/S2851/3/Senate/Content
subjects: proof of identity
what a license may be used as identification for
